nodes.title: Repair corrupted package.json so the Docker build passes
nodes.summary: Fix the logged deploy failure: `npm ci` fails with EJSONPARSE because package.json contains curly quotes and a stray wrapper (`{ “file”: “package.jso...`) instead of valid JSON. Restore it to real package.json content with straight quotes and the correct name, scripts and dependencies. Regenerate package-lock.json so it matches, and confirm `npm ci` succeeds locally and in a node:20.19.0-alpine container.

nodes.title: Verify the full Docker build and redeploy
nodes.summary: Once package.json is fixed, walk through all 15 Dockerfile steps, since only step 4 has been seen to fail and later steps (build, runtime stage, start command, exposed port) may hide further errors. Fix any that surface, then trigger a redeploy and confirm the app builds, starts and serves correctly.

nodes.title: Add safeguards against invalid config reaching deploys
nodes.summary: Prevent a repeat of this failure by adding a pre-deploy or CI check that validates package.json parses as JSON and that `npm ci` and the Docker build succeed. Add a .dockerignore and a note on editing config files in plain-text editors to avoid smart-quote substitution.
